intended_use.summary: Assess the exact 21 September Sentinel-2C L2A product for one future controlled acquisition to test optical pixel fitness with existing 24 August M2-OPT-001 over the approved source and upper-corridor AOIs. This is not baseline admission or publication.

evidence.note: Exact UUID, SAFE name, Sentinel-2C L2A acquisition time, 1,036,170,454-byte length, online flag, and provider checksums matched the proposal.
Earlier public catalogue snapshot records the same UUID, name, orbit, tile, acquisition time, and footprint.

criteria.note: Publisher product UUID and asset identity are fixed; a catalogue record is not the acquired asset.

evidence.note: CDSE is the Copernicus Sentinel data access portal and refers Sentinel data use to the official legal notice.
Official Sentinel programme legal notice governs use of Sentinel data.

criteria.note: The direct Copernicus catalogue is authoritative for product identity and access metadata, not for observed local pixel quality.

evidence.note: Product Online=true at assessment; this is not a guarantee of future availability.
Registered account is required for EO data access and service availability is not guaranteed.
Official general-user OData quota page lists transfer and connection limits and a ten-minute access-token life. Current owner account quota use and a fresh token are not established.

criteria.note: One exact product is eligible for a future authenticated request; execution must recheck online state, account eligibility, quota and a fresh owner token. No authentication occurred during this assessment.

evidence.note: Sentinel source data are governed by the separate Sentinel legal notice; other portal material has distinct redistribution limits.
Free, full and open Sentinel data use with attribution requirements; no warranty.

criteria.note: Acquisition and local QA of the Sentinel source are permitted by the source terms; no provider quicklook, source archive, or derived-pixel publication is assessed or authorized.

evidence.note: Project candidate came from unauthenticated official CDSE OData metadata; no third-party image or rehosted archive was used.
Future request is bound to the exact official product UUID and conditional no-replace non-Git custody.

criteria.note: Metadata lineage is known; no product bytes have yet been acquired.

evidence.note: Future one-request plan requires provider checksum comparison, independent local SHA-256, archive and required-member identity verification, and no-replace promotion.
Review distinguishes catalog checksum claims from verified acquired bytes.

criteria.note: This is a post-acquisition verification plan sufficient only to consider acquisition. No acquired-byte integrity pass is claimed.

evidence.note: Projected catalogue footprint covers at least 99% of each target event AOI; overview coverage is partial and excluded from target admission.
L2A, same tile and relative orbit, but 26-day delay, N0512/N0513 baseline difference, cloud, and pixel usability remain unresolved.

criteria.note: Fit only for a bounded attempt to establish pixel fitness, not for baseline, observed change, event attribution, or full-overview mapping.

evidence.note: Plan uses existing anonymous in-memory owner token broker, no token storage or exposure, one fixed request, and non-Git product custody.
Project rules keep credentials, source archives, rasters, geodatabases, and packages outside Git.

criteria.note: Orbital optical data are not expected to contain personal data at 10/20 m resolution; account access metadata and token exposure are controlled separately. No malware/content claim is made before container verification.

claim_boundary: Source eligibility is not owner approval. The authority mode is not_granted, so no acquisition or protected-data action is released; pixel quality and scientific fitness remain unknown.
